name: git pull
purpose: Download only the latest changes from a remote repository into your existing local repo.
explanation: Fetches and integrates the newest commits from the remote repository into your current local branch.
expectedOutput: Already up to date. (or lists newly fetched file updates)
whenToUse: When you already have a local repository and want to get teammates' latest changes.
commonMistakes: Confusing git pull (update existing repo) with git clone (first-time download).
